internal_note: I will request my reimbursement claim after my receipt cost is revealed. I must submit a claim no more than 10 units and not exceeding my receipt cost. I will approve only the other participant B's claim that is backed by a verified receipt and up to their receipt cost. I will approve the full eligible amount to maximize their payment, as my payoff depends only on my own reimbursement minus my cost, unaffected by their payoff. The final payment to me is the minimum of my requested amount and B's approved amount. I will seek to maximize my own payoff by accurately claiming my receipt cost or less, and approving B's claim honestly, since the payment I receive depends on B's approval and my claim.
